name: browser-llm
description: Gemma 3 1B browser AI (<=20MB chunks, RAM-only streaming, WebGPU + WASM)

scripts.verify-dist: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs=>{const walk=async d=>{for(const e of await fs.promises.readdir(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=d+'/'+e.name;if(e.isDirectory())await walk(p);else{const s=(await fs.promises.stat(p)).size;if(s>20000000)throw new Error('Oversized: '+p+' ('+s+')');}}};await walk('dist');console.log('dist verified: all files <= 20,000,000 bytes');})"
